about_the_game:
An open-world co-op action RPG played from a third-person perspective.

Overview

The world of Skylorn lies in ruins. Failed experiments to incorporate magic into their technology have devastated the lands, leaving behind crumbling cities, mutated areas and hostile machines. You are one of the new arrivals, a voyager from a distant colony, sent to reclaim and restore these lands.

Skylorn: Bound Together is an open-world action RPG designed for seamless co-op play. Whether alone or with up to three players, you’ll explore a vast handcrafted world, battle dangerous enemies, and develop your character through deep progression systems.

Gameplay

  • Third-person combat that blends shooting, melee, and magic. Use rifles, blades, and devastating arcane powers to overcome your foes.

  • Skill progression system with multiple paths. Specialize in ranged combat or close-quarters fighting, both with spellcasting — or create a hybrid build that suits your style.

  • Exploration-driven gameplay with quests, hidden dungeons, and environmental storytelling. Every direction reveals new dangers and mysteries.

  • Crafting and upgrades — collect rare ingredients and loot from fallen enemies to enhance your weapons.

Multiplayer

Built for co-op from the ground up, Skylorn: Bound Together is best experienced with friends:

  • Coordinate with teammates: shared inventory, revive each other in battle, and combine abilities for devastating synergies.

  • The whole game can be seamlessly played together. In-progress join is possible, the newly joined player will receive the same level the other players currently have and the inventory is always shared.

  • All players receive all experience points.

  • Joining a game is only possible via the Steam overlay, therefore its only possible to play with Steam friends.

  • Optimized for 2–3 players, though single-player is fully supported.

Open World

A dense, handcrafted world awaits:

  • Explore ruined cities, forgotten laboratories, and ancient structures buried beneath the earth.

  • Face both monstrous creatures and robots who will challenge your journey at every turn.

Key Features

  • Open-world sci-fi fantasy post-apocalyptic setting.

  • Seamless co-op multiplayer designed for 2–3 players (single-player is also supported).

  • Fast-paced third-person combat with ranged, melee, and magic abilities.

  • Deep progression system with skills, weapons, and upgrades.

  • A handcrafted world full of mysteries, quests, and hidden dungeons.

  • Crafting and weapon upgrade systems driven by exploration and loot.

name: Skylorn: Bound Together

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 8100
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070, or similar with min 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 13 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 8 Thread AMD Processor of 3000 Ryzen series
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 13 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: 60 FPS at native 1440p, at highest settings, SSD

short_description: Skylorn: Bound Together is a co-op open-world action RPG. You arrived from a distant colony and explore a post-apocalyptic sci-fi fantasy world, battle enemies, uncover mysteries—alone or with friends. Played from a third person perspective.
